name: Auto Steam Calculator
author: pponce; calculation and jug heuristic inspired by Damian / Damian-AU (DSx2)
description: Estimate steam duration from milk weight using your calibration. Inspired by Damian's DSx2 calculator. This estimates temperature through time; it does not measure milk temperature.

smallJugGrams.label: Small empty jug (g)
smallJugGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty small jug.

mediumJugGrams.label: Medium empty jug (g)
mediumJugGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty medium jug.

largeJugGrams.label: Large empty jug (g)
largeJugGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty large jug.

singleDrinkGrams.label: Usual milk per drink (g)
singleDrinkGrams.description: Milk only for one drink; used to infer jug size in Auto. This can differ from your calibration milk weight.

singleDrinkJug.label: Jug normally used for one drink
singleDrinkJug.description: Select small or medium to choose the jug-detection thresholds.

weightMode.label: Scale weight mode
weightMode.description: Gross includes the empty jug. Tared is milk only: jug size cannot be inferred and no jug weight is subtracted.

referenceMilkGrams.label: Calibration milk weight (g)
referenceMilkGrams.description: Milk only, excluding the jug, from your measured calibration run.

referenceSeconds.label: Time to your desired milk temperature (s)
referenceSeconds.description: Actual steaming time in the calibration run. Use similar milk, starting temperature and steaming technique for subsequent drinks.

referenceFlow.label: Auto steam flow (ml/s)
referenceFlow.description: Flow used for calibration and applied whenever Auto calculates a steam time.

referenceSteamTemperature.label: Calibration steam heater temperature (°C)
referenceSteamTemperature.description: Heater target used during calibration. Auto restores this target from Off when a time is calculated. This is not milk temperature.

maxSeconds.label: Maximum calculated duration (s)
maxSeconds.description: Reject longer results rather than silently shortening them. Whole seconds, 1–255.

defaultJug.label: Starting jug selection
defaultJug.description: Small, Medium or Large subtracts that jug weight. Auto guesses the jug using milk per drink. Streamline remembers subsequent preset selections.
